before.name: Housing cost burden
before.target: Affordable housing for all; <30% rent burden
before.source: City of Watsonville Housing Program; Santa Cruz Local
before.notes: Affordable housing rent limits: $1,627 (studio) to $2,510 (4BR). Market rate likely higher. Rising homelessness with smaller budget and fewer staff than SC city. No dedicated homelessness department. 20.4% decline in county-wide homelessness reported.

after.name: People experiencing homelessness on the PIT count night
after.source: Santa Cruz County Housing for Health Partnership / Applied Survey Research 2026 PITreport
after.notes: The 2026 PIT report, physical page 13, reports one-night counts by jurisdiction. Street enumeration occurred January 29, with shelter occupancy from January 28. The count excludes some forms of homelessness and is not annual persons served. Newly included safe parking/sleeping records added 124 people in Santa Cruz city and 2 in Watsonville compared with prior practice, so annual changes are not directly comparable. The legacy 1,850 was the 2024 COUNTY total, not Santa Cruz city. Housing cost burden remains a separate unresolved measure. No count-based score is inferred from the legacy combined prose target. Watsonville: 179 unsheltered + 124 sheltered = 303.
